profile.name: 微量液体泵
profile.description: 一种用于输送微升级液体的实验室泵，可按设定体积、流速和方向推动液体通过管路。常用于微流控、样品传输、试剂加样和流路预充等实验操作。
profile.description_en: A laboratory pump for moving microliter-scale liquids through tubing with defined volume, flow rate, and direction. It is commonly used for microfluidics, sample transfer, reagent delivery, and priming fluid lines.

registry.name: Miniature Pump
registry.description: Miniature Pump是一款注射泵，主要功能包括停止、泵送、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
